hint.full_measure: Default: fast precheck search, full window only for result points
hint.above_stock: Caution: above stock the test leaves the manufacturer's factory range (higher load, heat, wear). The hard wall frequency_max/core_max always stays active; a confirmation is required at start.
plan.fine_params: Fine parameters (optional, only for this plan)
card.curve.title: J/TH curve

card.history.title: History
hist.short_note: Verification run with short windows (120–180 s / 120 hits) – do NOT use for sweet-spot decisions.
hist.confirm_delete_all: Really delete ALL runs in the history? This cannot be undone.
hist.confirm_delete_selected: Delete {n} selected run(s)? This cannot be undone.
hist.confirm_delete_failed: Delete all failed runs (no valid measurement point)? Successful runs are kept.
hist.max_info: History keeps the newest {n} runs; older ones are deleted automatically.
hist.keep_failed_hint: If off, runs without any valid point are not kept in the history.
bf.label: Target hashrate (TH/s)
bf.enter_target: Please enter a target hashrate in TH/s.
bf.role.vmin_alternative: Vmin – more efficient, but without reserve
bf.caution.short_run: Verification run with short measurement windows – values statistically uncertain, do not use for permanent decisions.
bf.msg.above_max: Target {t} TH/s is above the highest measured point ({top} TH/s)
bf.msg.no_points: Run contains no valid result points.

Start sweep?

confirm.save:
Save this point permanently in the miner?

{f} MHz / {mv} mV

The miner will then start with this operating point.
msg.pin_too_short: PIN must have at least 4 characters
err.pin_not_set: Control PIN not set yet – set it above
err.export_missing: Export package missing – start control.py with the venv Python
err.pin_invalid: Invalid PIN (at least 4 characters, not CHANGEME)
err.sweep_running_url: Sweep running – miner URL cannot be changed
err.emergency_active: Emergency stop active – use “Resume mining” first
err.sweep_running_point: Sweep running – single point not possible
err.save_needs_confirm: Permanent save requires an additional confirmation
code.early_abort_warmup: early abort: underpowered {pct} % of expected after warmup (settled {settle_s} s)
code.early_abort_warmup_unsettled: early abort: underpowered {pct} % of expected after warmup (not settled)
code.early_abort_window_hashrate: early abort in window: {pct} % of expected (60 s average) after {secs} s
code.early_abort_window_noisy: early abort in window: {pct} % of expected ({avg_s} s average, noisy signal) after {secs} s
code.early_abort_window_error: early abort in window: error {err} % after {secs} s
code.below_linear: below linear expectation: {pct} % of expected (stable, err {err} %) – frequency scales sub-linearly
code.freq_unreachable: frequency not reachable at any voltage {floor}..{top} mV – skipped, trying higher frequency
code.band_target: Band around target frequency ~{f_target} MHz (× {lo_frac} .. × {hi_frac}), clamped to {min}–{max} MHz
code.gate_above_stock: The plan leaves the factory range (above stock). Confirmation required at start.
code.early_stop_rule: test ascending; stop as soon as the best J/TH per frequency rises {rises}× in a row (valley captured)
code.note_freq_capped: frequency upper limit {raw} MHz capped at wall frequency_max {max}
code.note_mv_capped: voltage upper limit {raw} mV capped at wall core_max {max}
code.note_target_needs_above: target {target} TH/s needs ~{f} MHz > f_high {f_high} – only reachable with 'allow above stock'
code.note_target_over_wall: target {target} TH/s needs ~{f} MHz > f_high {f_high} – beyond the wall
code.est_per_point: warmup ~{warmup} s + window (min {min} s, until {hits} hits, max {max} s) + {overhead} s
code.est_fast_perf: full window per frequency: {n} (Vmin); precheck ~{secs} s
code.est_fast_reserve: full window per frequency: {n} (Vmin + reserve); precheck ~{secs} s
code.derive_start_below_floor: start voltage {start} mV is below the floor {floor} mV
code.range_too_narrow: Neither frequency nor voltage range allows a sweep (frequency {fmin} .. {fmax} MHz, core_min {min} .. core_max {max}, stock {stock} mV) - only manual point setting is useful here.
code.voltage_fixed_freq_sweep: Voltage range too narrow for a Vmin search (core_min {min} .. core_max {max}, stock {stock} mV) - pure frequency sweep at fixed {mv} mV.
code.no_estimate: no hashrate estimate possible (miner status incomplete)
code.knee_segment_exceeds: segment to {freq}/{mv} > {factor} × reference – knee before it
code.knee_all_segments_ok: all segments ≤ {factor} × reference – highest Vmin point
